description: A prospect who wants Developer or Team can only see disabled 'Coming soon' buttons. There is no waitlist, contact link or email, and no message at the button. Clicking does nothing (no feedback), so the decision the visitor came to make cannot be started.
expected: A secondary action on paid cards such as 'Contact us' or 'Notify me', or a visible reason next to the disabled button.
actual: step-1-pricing.png; click on 'Coming soon' changes nothing.
suggested_fix: Replace the disabled buttons with a mailto/contact link when checkout is off.

description: The banner and the 'Additional usage' panel are written for the deployment operator ('when sign-in and storage are configured', 'this deployment', 'billing is fully configured', 'Stripe') rather than the prospect. The same 'checkout is not enabled' message appears three times (banner, 'Coming soon', Additional usage).
expected: One short visitor-facing message, for example 'Paid plans are not open yet. The Free plan is available.'; operator details go to console/admin only.
suggested_fix: Show operator text only to signed-in owners; show a one-line banner to visitors; hide the empty 'Additional usage on paid plans' panel when rates are unpublished.

description: The sign-up page (reached from 'Start with Free') shows only a card with an installation message and no link back to pricing, home or sign-in. A visitor who clicked the one enabled action reaches a page with no exit but the logo. (In a configured deployment this page would show the Clerk form; this finding covers only the unconfigured state.)
expected: A 'Back to pricing' link, or hide 'Start with Free' when sign-up is not configured.
suggested_fix: Add a back link in the unconfigured card; have /pricing check the same flag.

description: The disabled paid buttons point to the banner through aria-describedby (good), but sighted and touch users get no tooltip or inline reason next to the buttons. 'Open console' is the primary-styled nav action for signed-out visitors, which only bounces them to sign-in; 'Sign in' is the quieter link.
expected: Visible reason under the buttons; 'Sign in' as the signed-out action.
suggested_fix: Add a caption under the disabled buttons; show 'Sign in' as the primary nav button when signed out.
